remediation.message: The verified L1-L2-L3 chain is evidence for who authorized the agent and what was authorized. 279.99 USD is inside the 100.00-400.00 range, the SKU is on the line-item allowlist, and the listed unit price matches the charge. No behavior history is on file, so the decision is ALLOW_WITH_MONITORING rather than ALLOW. Nothing here revokes the grant.
